Within 45 days, you're running this workplace independently, with no hand-holding required. You've taken over every vendor relationship and contract, including Kilroy, resolving issues directly instead of escalating to HR or leadership. You've defined a calendar of company events for the year and have a plan in motion for each one. New hires walk in on day one fully set up, and offboarding happens without anyone having to chase it down. Expense reports are reconciled on a predictable cadence with no missing documentation.

**Why Join Hippocratic AI**
---------------------------

**Reinvent healthcare with AI that puts safety first.** We’re building the world’s first healthcare‑only, safety‑focused LLM — a breakthrough platform designed to transform patient outcomes at a global scale. This is category creation.

**Work with the people shaping the future.** Hippocratic AI was co‑founded by CEO Munjal Shah and a team of physicians, hospital leaders, AI pioneers, and researchers from institutions like El Camino Health, Johns Hopkins, Washington University in St. Louis, Stanford, Google, Meta, Microsoft, and NVIDIA.

**Backed by the world’s leading healthcare and AI investors.** We recently raised a $126M Series C at a $3.5B valuation, led by Avenir Growth, bringing total funding to $404M with participation from CapitalG, General Catalyst, a16z, Kleiner Perkins, Premji Invest, UHS, Cincinnati Children’s, WellSpan Health, John Doerr, Rick Klausner, and others.

**Build alongside the best in healthcare and AI.** Join experts who’ve spent their careers improving care, advancing science, and building world‑changing technologies — ensuring our platform is powerful, trusted, and truly transformative.

---------------------

* **Domain Knowledge:** Deep proficiency in Digital Marketing, with hands-on expertise or strong familiarity in SEO, AEO, content strategy, and web/IT infrastructure.

jobs.title: Senior Program Manager, Learning & Development - Tech
jobs.description:
Crusoe is on a mission *to accelerate the abundance of energy and intelligence*. As the only vertically integrated AI infrastructure company built from the ground up, we own and operate each layer of the stack — from electrons to tokens — to power the world's most ambitious AI workloads. When you join Crusoe, you join a team that is building the future, faster.

We're in the midst of the greatest industrial revolution of our time. The demand for AI compute is boundless, and power is a bottleneck. We're solving that — with an energy-first approach that makes AI infrastructure better for the world and faster for the people innovating with AI.

We're looking for problem-solving, opportunity-finding teammates with a sense of urgency, who believe in the scale of our ambition and thrive on a path not fully paved — people who want to grow their careers alongside a team of experts across energy, manufacturing, data center construction, and cloud services.

If you want to do the most meaningful work of your career, help our customers and partners advance their AI strategies, and be part of a high-performing team that believes in each other, come build with us at Crusoe.

**About the Role:**

As Senior Program Manager, Learning & Development - Tech, you will continue to develop and operate a best-in-class global Onboarding & Learning Programs for Crusoe’s global manager population. You will also develop and oversee Crusoe's Team Effectiveness Project. This role is ideal for an experienced L&D strategist who moves quickly, thrives in fast-paced environments, and brings instructional precision, big-picture thinking, and operational excellence.

You will balance high-level strategy with hands-on execution—designing and facilitating manager experiences, curating learning journeys for teams & individuals, and establishing data-driven feedback loops that resonate with our Tech population. Partnering directly with senior leaders across engineering, data center operations, and Employee Success you will ensure our Tech population is equipped to scale with Crusoe’s rapid growth.

**What You'll Be Working On:**

* Onboarding Program: Facilitation and partner with your teammates to keep our Crusoe Onboarding experience …
* Manager Program Facilitation: Facilitate and continuously evolve Crusoe’s Manager Program (“Manager Bootcamp”)

* Team Effectiveness: Work with Tech Employee Success Partners to understand what kind of support Tech teams need. Design & facilitate Tech team offsites, deliver Working Genius, DiSC and 5 Dysfunctions of a Team content.
* Modular & Functional Tracks: Partner with internal teams (HR / People, Talent Development, senior leadership) to build modular and team-specific development tracks tailored to technical, and data center operational teams.
* Program Operations & Metrics: Build robust measurement frameworks and feedback loops to evaluate program effectiveness, track leadership performance metrics, and optimize operational delivery.

**What You'll Bring to the Team:**

* 8–10+ Years of L&D Leadership: Proven track record in Learning & Development, Organizational Development, or Instructional Design, with explicit experience scaling manager programs inside technical, engineering organizations.
* Technical Org Fluency: Deep understanding of how engineering and technical operations leads work best, what motivates them, and how to build credibility in highly technical cultures.
* Data-Driven Approach: Expertise using workforce analytics and learning metrics to evaluate program ROI, identify performance risks, and justify strategic interventions.
* Program Execution: Equal parts strategic architect and hands-on builder; comfortable designing frameworks from scratch in ambiguous, fast-growing environments.
* Enthusiasm for Travel: Willingness and ability to travel to global offices, and data centers as needed (approx. 25% travel).

**Bonus Points**

* Organizational Development Background: Advanced grounding in adult learning theory or organizational effectiveness.
* Modern L&D Tech Stack: Hands-on familiarity with tools such as WorkRamp, Lattice, Confluence, or modern LMS/knowledge platforms.
* Infrastructure Tech Context: Genuine curiosity about AI systems, hardware manufacturing, and the physical data center infrastructure powering future technologies.
* Certified Trainer for Working Genius, DiSC, SLII, 5 Dysfunctions of a Team, etc

**Benefits:**

* Competitive compensation and equity packages
* Restricted Stock Units
* Paid time off, paid holidays & leave of absence programs
* Comprehensive health, dental & vision insurance
* Employer contributions to HSA account
* Paid parental leave
* Paid life insurance, short-term and long-term disability
* Professional development & tuition reimbursement
* Mental health & wellness support
* Commuter benefits (parking & transit)
* Cell phone stipend
* 401(k) Retirement plan with company match up to 4% of salary
* Volunteer time off
* Global travel insurance & emergency assistance
* Daily meals allowance
* Additional perks & programs specific to location

Compensation will be paid in the range of up to $160,000 - $195,000 + Bonus. Restricted Stock Units are included in all offers. Compensation to be determined by the applicant's knowledge, education, and abilities, as well as internal equity and alignment with market data.

**Account Manager – Client Partnerships & Liquidity Solutions**

**Location:** San Francisco, California 94102 (Downtown / Financial District)  
**Position Type:** Full-time, permanent, benefits-eligible (at-will employment)  
**Work Arrangement:** Hybrid – flexible mix of in-office and remote work  
**Compensation:** $6,500 – $8,700 gross per month (approximately $78,000 – $104,400 annually) + annual performance-based bonus (up to 15%)  
**Work Authorization:** Applicants must be legally authorized to work in the United States without requiring sponsorship

**Why This Role Stands Out**

This is not a typical account management position. You will be joining a specialized consulting firm where liquidity management, treasury advisory, and working capital optimization are the core of what we do. Our San Francisco office serves a sophisticated client base — industrial corporations, financial institutions, and investment funds — and we need someone who can grow into a trusted partner for those clients.

You will report to a Senior Account Manager and work alongside teams in Financial Consulting, Treasury Advisory, Compliance, Data Analytics, and Customer Success. If you are early in your career, hungry to learn, and want exposure to high-level financial consulting, this is the environment where that happens.

**What You'll Be Doing**

**Client Portfolio Coordination**  
Support the Senior Account Manager in overseeing a portfolio of domestic and international clients. Manage operational tasks, administrative workflows, and routine reporting to keep accounts running efficiently.

**Client-Facing Communication**  
Serve as the first point of contact for client inquiries regarding liquidity management services — cash forecasting, working capital optimization, cash flow management, and treasury operations. Ensure every response is timely, professional, and accurate.

**Consulting Project Support**  
Collaborate with senior consultants to gather and analyze client financial data. Assist with preparing reports, executive presentations, and commercial proposals. Track project milestones and flag issues that need escalation.

**New Client Onboarding**  
Guide new clients through the early stages of the relationship. Provide clear information about our services, collect required documentation, and help coordinate a smooth project kickoff.

**Reporting & Analysis**  
Prepare periodic reports on portfolio performance, project KPIs, liquidity metrics, and client satisfaction using CRM tools and advanced spreadsheets.

**Contributing to Team Goals**  
Support retention targets, customer satisfaction (CSAT) goals, upselling objectives, and overall portfolio growth.

* Bachelor's or Master's degree in Economics, Finance, Industrial Engineering, Political Science, or a related field.
* 0–2 years of professional experience in account management, customer success, commercial support, administrative coordination, or analytical roles. Relevant internship experience in consulting, corporate finance, treasury, or private banking is highly valued.
* Exposure to consulting firms, professional services, banking, fintech, treasury departments, or financial sector organizations is beneficial.

**Technical Competencies**

* Proficiency with Microsoft Office, particularly Excel for financial data analysis and reporting.
* Familiarity with CRM systems such as Salesforce or HubSpot.
* Ability to produce professional documents — reports, presentations, and client proposals.
* Basic understanding of liquidity management concepts (cash flow, working capital, treasury, banking relationships) is a strong advantage.

**Language Skills**

Proficiency in additional languages is highly welcomed and will be considered a valuable asset. Our firm serves international clients and operates with global consulting methodologies, so the ability to communicate in languages such as Italian, Spanish, French, or German will support your work with cross-border clients and international projects. English fluency is required for all internal and client-facing communication.

**Personal Attributes**

* Strong interpersonal and communication abilities, with a focus on active listening and empathy.
* Detail-oriented, organized, and capable of managing multiple priorities simultaneously.
* Proactive and intellectually curious, with a genuine desire to learn and grow.
* Effective problem-solver who can translate complex client needs into actionable steps.
* Collaborative team player who adapts well to a dynamic, fast-paced environment.

**Compensation & Benefits**

We believe that exceptional work deserves exceptional rewards. Our compensation philosophy is built on transparency, performance, and long-term partnership.

* **Performance Bonus:** Annual MBO bonus of up to 15%, determined by individual and team results.
* **Health Coverage:** Comprehensive medical, dental, and vision insurance.

jobs.title: Manager, Technical Account Management
jobs.description:
**About the Role**
------------------

Cyberhaven is looking for a Manager, Technical Account Management to build and lead the team of Technical Account Managers who own the technical relationship with our customers. Your team is accountable for how each customer deploys, adopts, and gets value from Cyberhaven's Agentic Data Security platform, from onboarding through renewal. You will hire and develop the team, define how TAMs work with accounts, and make sure customers get a consistent, proactive technical partner and experience.

You are a people leader with a technical background in security SaaS and endpoint agents, and you are comfortable in a fast-paced, high-growth environment where the team's processes are still being written. You will coach TAMs on and step in on critical escalations when needed. You will also work cross-functionally with Product, Engineering, Support Engineering, Customer Experience, and Sales to turn what the team learns from customers into improvements to the product and to how we serve customers.

Technical depth, a strong client focus, and experience leading customer-facing technical teams are required. You will report to the VP of Support and Technical Account Management.

**What You’ll Do**
------------------

### **Lead and grow the team**

* Hire, onboard, and develop Technical Account Managers. Set clear expectations, give regular feedback, and run career development and performance reviews.
* Coach TAMs on account strategy, technical troubleshooting, executive communication, and managing difficult customer situations.
* Build a team culture of growth mindset, ownership, curiosity, and accountability for customer outcomes.
* Plan headcount and coverage as the customer base grows, including how accounts are assigned and balanced across the team.

### **Define how the TAM function operates**

* Act as the senior escalation point for critical customer issues. Make sure TAMs bring clear reproductions and context to Engineering, and that customers stay informed through resolution.
* Build relationships with customes, and join executive and business reviews for strategic accounts.
* Work with Customer Success and Sales on renewals, expansions, and risk mitigation, providing technical input and account insight.

### **Be the voice of the customer**

* Collect customer feedback, feature requests, and recurring issues from the team and bring them to Product Management and Engineering with the technical and business context behind them.
* Work with Engineering and Support Engineering to improve diagnostics, debugging tools, and escalation processes.
* Run root cause analysis reviews on significant incidents and drive preventive follow-ups so issues do not repeat.
* Stay current on industry trends, security best practices, and adjacent technologies such as SIEM, SOAR, and UEBA, and bring them into the team's guidance to customers.

* 3+ years of experience managing a team of Technical Account Managers, Support Engineers, Solutions Engineers, or similar customer-facing technical staff.

* Track record of hiring, developing, and retaining strong technical people, and of handling performance issues directly and fairly.
* Experience building or scaling a TAM, Support, or Customer Success function, including processes, playbooks, and metrics.
* Demonstrated ability to own customer technical outcomes from implementation through steady-state operation, and to understand a customer's architecture and environment end-to-end.
* Hands-on experience deploying, supporting, and troubleshooting SaaS-based security and/or endpoint agent technologies.
* Proven experience managing escalated technical customer issues and working directly with engineering teams.
* Excellent verbal and written communication skills (English), including the ability to engage both hands-on practitioners and executive stakeholders.
* Strong organizational and planning skills, with the ability to manage multiple priorities, set timelines, and track progress across a team and its accounts.
* Practical knowledge of networking, security products, enterprise network infrastructure, and Windows, macOS, and Linux endpoint management (SCCM, GPO, Intune, MDM, and application management).
* Ability to read and interpret logs and diagnostic output across Windows, macOS, Linux, and Google Kubernetes Engine well enough to coach others and guide technical investigations.

### **Desired**

* Familiarity with adjacent technologies that Cyberhaven integrates with (SIEM, SOAR, UEBA).
* Expertise with DLP, Insider Threat, and CASB solutions.
* Prior experience leading a TAM team at a security or SaaS company.
* Experience working in an early-stage or high-growth company where the team's processes were still being defined.
* Background in L2/L3 or Escalation Engineering for EDR or DLP tools.

Joining Cyberhaven means joining the team building Data Security for the Agentic Enterprise. Traditional tools fall short. jobs.title: Case Manager II Eddy Street Apartments
jobs.description:
Position: Case Manager II  
Program: Eddy Street Apartments  
Location: Tenderloin, San Francisco  
Reports To: Deputy Director of Housing Support Services  
Status: Non-Exempt, Union  
Schedule: 9am-5pm, M-F  
Wage: $30.44/hour  
  
Community Forward SF is a collection of vital programs that ensures our neighbors experiencing  
homelessness have effective services designed for their unique needs. Whether one needs  
housing, medical shelter, a safe place to recover, or calm in the face of domestic violence – we care  
for those most vulnerable in our community. We are not just one program. We are a network of  
programs designed to work together to meet every stage of need. We focus on the  
hardest-to-reach, most vulnerable people: Women, Medical Crisis, Substance Use Disorder, and  
Older Adults. Our programs meet the needs of people, rather than demanding that people meet  
the needs of our programs.  
JOB SUMMARY:  
Community Forward SF is hiring a Case Manager II. The Case Manager II primarily supports  
women living with HIV who participate in an approximately 18-month transitional housing  
program designed to support stability, health, and transition to permanent housing. The position  
also provides case management and housing stabilization support to permanent supportive  
housing (PSH) residents at Eddy Street Apartments.  
The Case Manager partners with residents to identify strengths, needs, and self-defined goals and  
provides person-centered support to promote health, housing stability, safety, and  
self-determination. Services include case management assessment and service planning,  
therapeutic engagement, housing stabilization and transition support, advocacy, benefits  
assistance, care coordination, systems navigation, information and education, referrals, and  
connection to community-based resources and providers.  
We are looking for an experienced Case Manager with strong behavioral health knowledge,  
excellent engagement and crisis de-escalation skills, and experience supporting adults with  
complex needs. The Case Manager builds collaborative relationships with residents, supports  
resident-identified goals, helps residents navigate housing, health care, behavioral health, benefits,  
and other systems, and recognizes when additional behavioral health, medical, crisis, or other  
specialized support is needed.  
ESSENTIAL JOB FUNCTIONS:  

* Establish and maintain a primary caseload of women living with HIV participating in the

transitional housing program and provide case management and housing stabilization  
support to PSH residents as assigned.  
  

* Build collaborative, trauma-informed relationships with residents using therapeutic

engagement strategies that support trust, autonomy, self-determination, and progress  
toward resident-identified goals.  

* Conduct intakes and case management assessments to identify resident strengths, needs,

priorities, resources, and self-identified goals, and orient new residents to their housing  
program, program expectations, available services, staff, and community resources.  

* Meet regularly with residents to collaboratively develop, implement, and update Individual

Service Plans (ISPs) based on case management assessment and centered on  
resident-identified goals, strengths, needs, individual timelines, and personal choices.  

* Support transitional housing participants in identifying and working toward goals related

to HIV and other health care, behavioral health, benefits, income, community connection,  
housing readiness, and transition to permanent housing.  

* Support residents living with HIV in accessing and remaining engaged with HIV care and

treatment by identifying and addressing barriers such as transportation, scheduling,  
benefits, stigma, and systems navigation and by coordinating with outside providers as  
appropriate.  

* Support PSH residents with housing retention and stabilization, including identifying and

addressing barriers that may affect successful tenancy and connecting residents with  
appropriate resources and services.  

* Respond to crises with a calm, grounded presence; identify immediate safety concerns, use

appropriate de-escalation strategies, follow established safety and crisis-response  
protocols, and engage supervisors, behavioral health providers, mobile crisis services,  
emergency services, or other appropriate resources when additional intervention is  
needed.  

* Recognize observable changes in behavior, functioning, or well-being that may indicate

increased behavioral health, substance use, medical, interpersonal violence, or other  
safety concerns; respond within the Case Manager role, communicate concerns through  
established channels, and support connection to appropriate services.  

* Support residents in accessing and remaining connected to psychiatric, behavioral health,

substance use, medical, and other health care services, including assistance with referrals,  
scheduling, transportation, communication with providers, and other barriers to care.  

* Coordinate with outside health, behavioral health, housing, benefits, and other service

providers when appropriate and authorized by the resident, including facilitating warm  
handoffs and supporting continuity of care.  

* Maintain appropriate releases of information and protect resident privacy and

confidentiality, including heightened confidentiality requirements related to HIV and other  
health information.  

* Support residents in accessing and maintaining benefits, income, health insurance, housing

resources, and other services that contribute to stability and resident-identified goals.  

* Support transitional housing participants with housing referrals and preparation for

permanent housing, including obtaining and maintaining identification and other necessary  
housing documentation and coordinating transitions and warm handoffs to permanent  
housing and ongoing serv

BitGo is the leader in digital asset financial services, providing institutional investors with liquidity, custody, and security solutions. Founded in 2013, BitGo pioneered the multi-signature wallet and is the first digital asset company to focus exclusively on serving institutional clients. Active in both centralized and decentralized finance, BitGo offers market leading trading, lending, and borrowing services through its prime brokerage services and acts as the custodian for WBTC, the leading global stablecoin for Bitcoin. In 2020, BitGo launched BitGo Portfolio and Tax, providing clients with a full-stack solution for digital assets. In 2018, it launched BitGo Trust Company, the first qualified custodian purpose-built for storing digital assets. BitGo processes approximately 20% of all global Bitcoin transactions, and supports over 600 coins and tokens. BitGo provides the security and operational backbone for more than 1500 institutional clients in 50 countries, including many regulated entities and the world's top cryptocurrency exchanges and platforms. BitGo is backed by Goldman Sachs, Craft Ventures, Digital Currency Group, DRW, Galaxy Digital Ventures, Redpoint Ventures, and Valor Equity Partners.

The BitGo Prime team is a dynamic, high performing group that provides critical operational service to our institutional trading, lending, and borrowing clients in partnership with our Trust custody and compliance entity; global account managers and salespeople; and finance and accounting. Our extended unit consists of a diverse group of trading, lending, and KYC/AML professionals with extensive backgrounds in traditional and crypto-finance, including front, middle, and back office.

The Prime Client Services Associate will be responsible for managing business operations for BitGo Prime's digital asset trading and financing services.

**RESPONSIBILITIES**:

* Manage BitGo Prime's trade and settlement workflows including trade entry, asset transfers, reporting and reconciliation.
* Collaborate with Prime's business team to maintain optimal funding across various trading venues
* First line of support for trading or financing operations related enquiries
* Lead process improvements, identify gaps, recommend improvements and automation
* Support testing efforts for all enhancements of proprietary systems
* Produce daily, weekly and monthly reporting for internal and external stakeholders
* Assist the Sales and Client Services team with on-boarding new counterparties
* Identifying operational risks, introduce operational controls and document policies & procedures
* Collaborate closely with the product/engineering team to improve our products and services
* Develop and maintain relationships with clients, exchanges, liquidity providers and third party providers
* Stay up to date about market trends, opportunities, risks and new projects, with a passion for the digital asset industry

**SKILLS AND EXPERIENCE:**

BitGo is looking for people who are passionate about their craft, take full ownership for their work and projects, and believe in transparent and collaborative culture with the goal of making BitGo successful.

* Incredible attention to detail and organizational skills
* Able to effectively interact with others in a pleasant, professional manner
* Strong analytical skills and ability to understand assets flows and procedures
* Must have previous middle or back-office experience in a financial services Trading, stock loan, FX experience is a plus.
* Experience managing and interacting with clients is a plus
* Comfortably manage competing priorities in a fast-moving, dynamic start-up environment
* Hands-on Excel or Google Sheets experience; macro programming exposure is a plus
* Genuine interest in financial services and cryptocurrency; crypto experience professionally or personally is a plus
* Bachelor's degree from an accredited university, or equivalent experience

**Why Join BitGo?**

Disrupting an industry takes vision, innovation, passion, technical chops, drive to deliver, collaboration, and execution. Join a team of great people who strive for excellence and personify our corporate values of ownership, craftsmanship, and open communication. We are looking for new colleagues who bring innovative ways of thinking and problem solving, and who want risks to be part of the team that changes the world's financial markets.

Cryptocurrencies are the most disruptive change the financial services industry has seen in years. Join us and you'll be able to look back and say you were part of the team that transformed investing.

jobs.description:
POSITION DESCRIPTION

**Position Title:** Physical Wellness Program Coordinator

**Status:** Full time, non-exempt

**Location:** Remote, preference for Texas residency

**Reports To:** Director of Physical Wellness and Sports and Recreation

**ATTENTION: Only applicants who submit a cover letter detailing why they are interested in Hope For The Warriors as well as explaining their connection to the military community will be considered . All applications MUST include: a resume, cover letter AND a complete list of any current nutrition, fitness, strength & conditioning, wellness certifications**. **Adaptive Sport Experience preferred. Please note responses must be original and written by the applicant. AI-generated submissions will not be reviewed.**

**This is an early career opportunity. Candidates with advanced degrees will also not be considered.**

**Background:**

Established in 2006, Hope For The Warriors® (Hope) is a civilian, 501(c)(3) non-profit organization. The mission of Hope For the Warriors® is to restore the quality of life for post-9/11 service members, their families, and families of the fallen who have sustained physical and psychological wounds in the line of duty. Hope For The Warriors® is dedicated to restoring a sense of self, restoring the family unit, and restoring hope for our service members and our military families.

**Core Values:**  
Hope For The Warriors® understands the challenges, pride, and joy of being a military family. For today, tomorrow, and years to come, we will strive to meet the changing needs of service members and their families. Additionally, we value community. Through our grassroots philosophy of interacting with the communities Veterans live and work in, we establish and nurture the relationships that have become the foundation of our support.

**Position Summary:**  
The Physical Wellness Program Coordinator engages members of the Warrior Community—veterans, transitioning service members, and their families—in activities that promote physical health and emotional well-being. The coordinator delivers direct support, facilitates goal setting, and manages participation in HOPE’s Physical Wellness Programs: Individual Athlete, Adaptive Equipment, and Team HOPE. This role supports clients through one-on-one communication, intake and goal assessments, motivational coaching, and event coordination. It also strengthens connections between physical activity and mental health, guiding clients toward improved quality of life. This is conducted within the scope of a holistic person-centered approach to well-being which is anchored within the delta of mind, body, and spirit.

**Primary Role:**

The Physical Wellness Program Coordinator provides communication, evaluation and resources to all clients who are seeking opportunities to better their physical health and wellness. The Program Coordinator conducts engagement calls and written communication to incoming HOPE clientele (athletes) to create, foster and establish a trusting, confident and reliable relationship. The Program Coordinator will conduct initial interest surveys and goal setting sessions with the purpose of understanding the physical well-being needs of the client.

The Program Coordinator provides social support, and event management services within Physical Wellness programming. These programs include Individual Athlete, Adaptive Equipment, and Team HOPE. As a regional MAY 2026 staff member, the coordinator will attend and facilitate programmatic events where they will welcome athletes and provide team-building experience.

Program Coordinator duties include assessing the needs of post 9/11 service members, veterans and their families within a client-centered approach, the connection between physical movement and mental wellbeing as well as the general physical fitness guidelines for healthy adults. The coordinator provides supportive communication, to include providing resources that support goals of clients, providing internal platforms for clients to connect to others socially, and provide aid when client may need assistance from other areas of the organization.

**Primary Responsibilities:**

* Conduct initial outreach and personalized goal-setting sessions focused on physical fitness, rehabilitation, and holistic well-being.
* Assess each client’s physical health status, fitness level, motivation, and potential barriers, using evidence-based wellness frameworks.
* Develop and implement individualized wellness action plans incorporating principles of adaptive fitness, injury prevention, and strength-building.
* Provide consistent coaching that integrates physical training concepts, behavioral motivation, and the connection between physical movement and mental health.
* Facilitate access to HOPE’s Physical Wellness programs, including Team HOPE, Individual Athlete, and Adaptive Equipment opportunities.
* Educate clients on physical activity guidelines for healthy adults, including progressive overload, flexibility, cardiovascular endurance, and nutrition basics.
* Track and document all client interactions, milestones, and outcomes in Salesforce to support data-informed program delivery.
* Coordinate participant recruitment, preparation, and logistics for Team HOPE events; provide on-site support and team-building experiences.
* Travel to and represent HOPE at national physical wellness events (supporting at least 50% of events in person).
* Collaborate with interdisciplinary HOPE staff to ensure clients are connected to financial, emotional, and social support services.
* Maintain strict compliance with HIPAA and data privacy standards; ensure thorough documentation of client progress and service delivery.
* Contribute to ongoing program development, quality assurance, and evaluation efforts to refine the impact of physical wellness services.

**Required Qualifications:**

* Bachelor’s degree in kinesiology, recreational therapy, behavioral health, or related field.
* 1-3 years’ ex

jobs.title: Senior Regulatory Quality Program Manager
jobs.description:
Join the transformative team at City of Hope, where we're changing lives and making a real difference in the fight against cancer, diabetes, and other life-threatening illnesses. City of Hope’s growing national system includes its Los Angeles campus, a network of clinical care locations across Southern California, a new cancer center in Orange County, California, and treatment facilities in Atlanta, Chicago and Phoenix. our dedicated and compassionate employees are driven by a common mission: To deliver the cures of tomorrow to the people who need them today.

**\*\* This is a Fully Remote Opportunity within the United States\*\***

**Position Summary:**

The Senior Regulatory Quality Program Manager is responsible for ensuring the organization complies with regulatory requirements through quality performance measurement, data integrity, and EHR-enabled reporting programs. This position will support enterprise regulatory quality programs, including development and implementation of EHR-aligned workflows, data capture processes, and performance measurement frameworks. Responsible for staying up to date with federal and state regulatory requirements and translating requirements into quality measure specifications, reporting logic, and data capture workflows within the EHR and analytics platforms. This position provides the connection between healthcare clinical federal and state regulatory programs, EHR systems, data structures, and regulatory quality performance outcomes.

The Senior Regulatory Quality Program Manager is responsible for leading and coordinating enterprise-level programs that support regulatory compliance, quality performance reporting, regulatory measurement, and EHR-enabled compliance programs across City of Hope. This role operates in close partnership with executive leadership to support enterprise-wide regulatory strategy, program execution, and performance oversight.

**As a successful candidate, you will:**

**Regulatory Quality Metrics, Data, and Program Execution:**

Serves as a subject matter expert in healthcare regulatory programs, including CMS quality reporting and interoperability requirements, with a primary focus on quality performance measurement and data integrity. Monitors evolving federal and state regulatory requirements and translates these into regulatory measure specifications, reporting logic, and EHR-aligned data capture workflows.

Coordinates the planning, implementation, and execution of regulatory programs (e.g., MIPS, eCQMs, registry-based submissions), ensuring accurate, timely, and compliant reporting. Evaluates the operational and financial impact of regulatory performance and supports optimization of data capture, documentation, and reporting processes.

Partners with Quality Analytics, Clinical Operations, and Information Technology teams to align EHR workflows, data structures, and report outputs with regulatory requirements. Provides guidance and education to stakeholders on measure definitions, documentation standards, and regulatory program expectations. Ensures measurable outcomes through consistent tracking of performance metrics, reporting deliverables, and program milestones.

**Quality Performance Measurement, Validation, and Improvement:**

* Leads ongoing evaluation of regulatory quality measure performance, including data completeness, accuracy, and alignment between clinical workflows and reporting requirements. Validates measure logic, including numerator/denominator integrity, inclusion/exclusion criteria, and data mapping across EHR and reporting systems.
* Analyzes complex performance data to identify gaps, variation, and opportunities for improvement, and recommends EHR build changes, workflow modifications, and documentation enhancements to improve measure performance and reporting accuracy.
* Coordinates data collection and abstraction activities across assigned resources to support regulatory submissions, including prioritization of work, issue resolution, and alignment to measure specifications and timelines. Collaborates with clinical, operational, and analytics stakeholders to resolve discrepancies and ensure consistency in reported data.
* Develops and maintains documentation of regulatory measure logic, data definitions, workflows, and reporting processes to support validation, auditability, and sustainable program execution. Supports clinical leadership in operationalizing regulatory quality programs and performance improvement initiatives aligned with organizational goals.
* Follows established City of Hope and department policies, procedures, objectives, performance improvement, attendance, safety, environmental, and infection control guidelines, including adherence to the workplace code of Conduct and Compliance Plan.
* Practices a high level of integrity and honesty in maintaining confidentiality.
* Performs other related duties as assigned or requested.

**Your qualifications should include:**

**Minimum Education:**

* Bachelor’s degree in healthcare, information systems, business or related field

**Minimum Experience:**

* Seven years of relevant experience in healthcare regulatory programs, quality analytics, clinical informatics, or program management within a healthcare environment
* Demonstrated experience working with regulatory quality reporting, EHR-based data capture, and cross-functional program coordination required

**City of Hope employees pay is based on the following criteria: work experience, qualifications, and work location.**

**City of Hope is an equal opportunity employer.**

**To learn more about our Comprehensive Benefits, please****CLICK HERE****.**

jobs.title: Operations Manager
jobs.description:
Operations and Automation Manager  
Link 360 | Remote (US) | Full time  
$60,000-$70,000 base, $85,000-$95,000 target total comp

We run outbound revenue programs for our clients. A client signs, and thirty days later they have a working team including the technology that helps it run: a CRM built out, email and LinkedIn campaigns live, a dedicated Sales Development Rep on the phones, and meetings landing on their calendar.

Right now about sixty separate tasks stand between the signature and the launch, and all of them are manual. We're hiring the person who takes that over and then makes most of it run without a person touching it. – Not to replace you, to streamline what you have to do so you can focus on critical human operational activities.

That second part is the actual job. If you've built AI agents and automations that do real work unattended, you'd be designing the automation layer for this entire company from scratch. No legacy system to work around, no committee, direct line to the founder. Build it well and the job gets smaller every quarter, you.. get more focused on the most valuable activities we can’t or don’t want to automate with Ai. Which is exactly what we're paying for.

**What you'd do**

Build the client systems. GoHighLevel sub-accounts, pipelines, calendars, forms, workflows. Sending domains and DNS, mailbox warmup, A2P registration, dialer setup, CRM integrations. If a workflow breaks at 7am you're the one who knows why.

Automate the onboarding. Take the sixty-task launch checklist and cut it down. Agents, automations, templates, whatever works. We'll set a baseline in your first week and part of your bonus is paid on how far you move it.

Produce the campaigns. Each client segment needs an email sequence, a LinkedIn sequence, an SDR call guide, a one-page document, and a landing page. You'll use AI to produce them and edit until they don't read like AI wrote them.

Approve the data. Our data team builds the lists. You check them, filter them, scrub them, and decide what gets imported. A bad list wastes a month of calling.

Run SDR coaching. Weekly call recording reviews, written feedback, role plays, and updates to the call guide based on what you hear. You run the routine and improve it.

Document everything. You're the first person in this seat. What you build becomes the training system for everyone after you.

**What we need you to already have**

You've built AI agents or multi-step automations that run on their own and do real operational work. Content, enrichment, reporting, QA, handoffs between systems. This one isn't negotiable and we'll ask you to walk us through what you built.

Two to four years in marketing ops, revenue ops, sales ops, or agency account management, with your hands in the tools rather than overseeing someone else's.

You've built inside a CRM and marketing automation platform. GoHighLevel is a big plus. Serious build work in HubSpot, ActiveCampaign, Keap, or Salesforce counts if you pick up platforms fast.

You understand cold email infrastructure. SPF, DKIM, DMARC, warmup, deliverability troubleshooting.

You write well. Some of what you produce goes out under a client's name.

You're organized past the point other people find reasonable. Checklists, documentation, follow-through. Our launch dates are contractual and about sixty things have to happen in thirty days to hit one.

**What we offer**

$60,000 to $70,000 base depending on experience and location, with the top of the range for someone who already has both the AI build background and the operations background. Performance pay on top, paid on task completion and on-time launches, automation you build that measurably cuts manual work, on-time client deliverables, and client retention. Target total is $85,000 to $95,000 in year one and grows past six figures as the client portfolio grows.

Fully remote. We're based in Phoenix and work nationally. Some overlap with Mountain Time required.

Real ownership, which at our size means something. You'll be building the system this company runs on instead of maintaining someone else's.

**How to apply**

Send a resume and a short note covering two things: an automation or agent you built that's still running, and the messiest process you've ever cleaned up. We read these. A generic cover letter tells us nothing.

Pay: $85,000.00 - $95,000.00 per year

Benefits:

* 401(k)
* Flexible schedule
* Health insurance
* Paid time off

Application Question(s):

* Do you have experience building Ai automation and/or Ai Employees?
* Do you have experience improving operations and service delivery for a company inside a business services industry?

Work Location: Remote

DLB recognizes salary ranges from job boards do not necessarily reflect our pay ranges. In many instances we out-compete those ranges for well-qualified candidates.

**Job Summary**

The Power Solutions – Project Manager is accountable for leading and delivering electrical power solutions projects for mission critical facilities, including hyperscale data centers, utility, renewable, industrial, and energy storage environments. The role combines project leadership with broad technical coordination across electrical infrastructure, system design, energy storage, microgrid, interconnection, protection and control, and related power delivery needs.

The Project Manager works closely with internal engineering teams, clients, utilities, vendors, subconsultants, and external stakeholders to define project needs and ensure solutions are delivered accurately, on schedule, and within budget, while maintaining alignment with DLB standards, client requirements, applicable codes, and industry best practices.

The Project Manager will receive limited direction on day-to-day work and general instruction on new projects or assignments. Will execute and assist project leadership on projects of complex scope. Will work independently or under limited supervision and may coordinate the work of others.

The Project Manager will communicate and operate in line with organizational goals and values, as well as departmental objectives.

**Manage all Elements of Routine and Complex Projects (50%)**

* Lead power solutions projects from kickoff through final design, procurement support, construction coordination, commissioning, energization, and closeout, as applicable to the assigned scope.
* Coordinate and oversee multidisciplinary technical activities related to electrical distribution, medium- and high-voltage systems, substations, generation, energy storage, microgrids, inverter-based resources, backup power, and associated controls.

jobs.description:
XO Health believes healthcare is fixable. Become part of the community changing the face of the industry.

XO Health is the first health plan designed by and for self-insured employers that delivers a more unified health experience for everyone – from those who receive care, to those who deliver it, to those who pay for it.

We are growing a multi-disciplinary team of diverse and digitally empowered employees ready to rebuild trust in healthcare through comprehensive and unified transformation.

**ABOUT XO HEALTH:**

XO Health is a technology-driven health plan built for self-insured employers. We serve employers, members, and providers through a value-based care network, a risk contracting engine, and a real-time data and analytics platform. We are a small, fast-moving team where every person owns outcomes, not just tasks.

**ABOUT THE ROLE:**

The Implementation Lead owns the end-to-end onboarding of new employer groups and TPA partners, from signed agreement through effective date and a stable first 60 days. You are the single point of accountability for a clean, on-time go-live: the plan is built correctly, eligibility flows, ID cards and welcome kits land, the member app is configured, and the client knows exactly where things stand at every step.

This is a hands-on, build-the-playbook role. You will run implementations yourself while standardizing how XO does them, so that each one is faster and cleaner than the last. You will work across Commercial, Plan Operations, Claims, Network, IT, and Compliance, and you will be the person clients, brokers, and TPAs trust to get them live.

  

**RESPONSIBILITIES:**

**Client and TPA Onboarding:**

* Lead the full implementation lifecycle for new employer groups and TPA partners, from kickoff through effective date and post-go-live stabilization.
* Build and maintain the implementation plan for each client: benefit design and plan documents, group structure, eligibility and enrollment setup, stop-loss coordination, vendor and partner integrations, member communications, and compliance requirements.
* Own the accurate setup of each group across XO's systems and partner platforms, including benefit configuration, eligibility file testing, ID card and welcome kit production, member app configuration, and any SSO or portal integrations.
* Translate client-specific requirements into clear instructions for internal teams and confirm they are executed correctly before go-live.

**Project Management:**

* Run the cross-functional implementation team and ensure critical milestones are completed. Surface risks early, resolve blockers, and escalate with a recommendation when needed.
* Coordinate with Claims, Plan Operations, Network, IT, Compliance, and Finance to ensure ownership is properly assigned and dates are adhered to .
* Maintain a regular reporting cadence with leadership and flag anything that puts a go-live at risk.

**Client Communication:**

* Serve as the primary contact for the client, broker, and TPA throughout implementation. Lead recurring status meetings and keep a clear record of open items and decisions.
* Prepare client-facing implementation documentation, checklists, and readiness sign-offs.
* Hand off cleanly to the ongoing account owner at the end of the stabilization period, with full documentation of the group's setup and any open items.

**Playbook and Continuous Improvement:**

* Own XO's implementation playbook: standard timelines, checklists, templates, and data requirements for employer and TPA onboarding.
* Identify manual steps and failure points in the process and work with Operations and Product to automate or remove them.
* Turn lessons from each implementation into playbook improvements that strengthen the process and enable scale ahead of growth.

**EXPERIENCE and EDUCATION:**

**Required:**

* 5+ years in implementation, client onboarding, or project management within self-funded health benefits, TPA operations, or a health plan.
* Working knowledge of self-funded medical and pharmacy plan design, and the compliance landscape that comes with it (ERISA, ACA, CAA, Mental Health Parity).
* Direct experience running complex, multi-party healthcare implementations on a fixed effective date.
* Fluency in the employer and TPA distribution channel, including how brokers, consultants, benefits administrators, and stop-loss carriers fit together.
* Comfort with eligibility files, enrollment data, and system configuration. You do not need to be technical, but you need to be precise and unafraid of the details.
* Clear, concise communicator who can confidently lead client discussions and provide leadership with direct, well-informed answers.
* Strong organizational skills and the judgment to prioritize when everything feels urgent.

**Preferred**:

* Experience implementing on behalf of, or alongside, a TPA.
* Experience at an early-stage or high-growth company where you built the process rather than inherited it.
* Familiarity with health plan technology platforms, member apps, or provider directory tools.
* PMP or similar project management credentials.

**KEY PERSONAL AND PROFESSIONAL ATTRIBUTES:**

***Accountability:*** you own the outcome and say so when something is off track.

***Critical Thinking:*** you solve problems from first principles and learn what the organization needs next.

***Change Champion:*** you are committed to building and comfortable when the plan changes.

***Relationships:***you build trust quickly with clients, partners, and colleagues.

The Commissioning Project Manager provides technical support and leadership to plan, schedule and execute full life cycle commissioning of critical facilities. The Commissioning Project Manager is responsible for supporting all aspects of a project. This person will work as part of the project team and interact closely with the owners, designers, contractors, subcontractors and other trades on projects in mission critical environments.

This person will collaborate with design engineers, construction contractors, equipment vendors, client staff and the DLB commissioning team to test, validate and make operational newly installed and operational electrical and mechanical systems including those in mission critical facilities.

The Commissioning Project Manager will receive limited directions on day-to-day work and general instruction on new projects or assignments. Will execute commissioning and assist project leadership on projects of complex scope. Will work independently or under limited supervision.

jobs.title: Senior Business Resilience Program Manager
jobs.location: San Francisco Bay Area, CA, USA
jobs.description:
Block is one company built from many blocks, all united by the same purpose of economic empowerment. The blocks that form our foundational teams — People, Finance, Counsel, Hardware, Information Security, Platform Infrastructure Engineering, and more — provide support and guidance at the corporate level. They work across business groups and around the globe, spanning time zones and disciplines to develop inclusive People policies, forecast finances, give legal counsel, safeguard systems, nurture new initiatives, and more. Every challenge creates possibilities, and we need different perspectives to see them all. Bring yours to Block.

#### **The Role**

Block’s Business Resilience is part of the Security Governance Risk and Compliance team. The Business Resilience helps ensure that critical products, services, operations, and supporting technology can continue through disruption and recover within expected timeframes. The team partners across business, technology, risk, compliance, legal, regional entities, and third-party teams to identify resilience risks, validate recovery capabilities, support governance expectations, and drive practical remediation.

This role will help operate and mature Block’s resilience program across business continuity, disaster recovery, crisis management, operational resilience, third-party resilience, testing, reporting, and regulatory compliance support. The role requires someone who can translate resilience requirements into clear business and technology actions, communicate risk in a practical way, and support accountable owners through testing, remediation, and governance.

The ideal candidate is also comfortable improving how resilience work gets done. They should be able to identify manual or repeatable workflows, support AI-enabled and automation opportunities, improve reporting and dashboards, help administer resilience tooling, and build scalable templates, evidence processes, and self-service mechanisms that reduce friction while improving quality, auditability, and regulatory confidence.

#### **You Will**

* Identify resilience risks across critical services, business functions, technology, and dependencies, including risks introduced by business, regulatory, or industry changes.
* Develop and maintain current, testable business continuity, disaster recovery, and crisis management plans aligned with recovery objectives, strategies, and resource needs.
* Coordinate resilience exercises and recovery tests, report findings, and partner with accountable owners to track remediation through completion.
* Assess third-party continuity and recovery capabilities, identify gaps, and support remediation.
* Communicate resilience posture, open risks, and decisions needed to governance forums, senior leaders, and Boards, and support audit, regulatory, customer, and RFP requests.
* Partner with regional entities, including the UK, EU, and Canada, to align global practices with local requirements and reduce duplication through shared controls, evidence, and reporting.
* Improve resilience workflows through AI, automation, dashboards, templates, and self-service tools, supporting requirements, testing, adoption, and troubleshooting with appropriate data, access, auditability, and human review controls.

#### **You Have**

* 6+ years of experience operating or improving global resilience, business continuity, disaster recovery, crisis management, or related risk programs, ideally in financial services or regulated technology.
* Strong knowledge of impact analysis, dependency mapping, recovery strategies, testing, remediation, and governance, with experience applying relevant standards or regulatory expectations (i.e. ISO22301, BS11200, FFIEC, EBA, FCI, CBI, or RPAA).
* Strong project management, organizational, and partnership skills, with the ability to manage deadlines and dependencies and drive cross-functional follow-through without direct authority.
* Excellent communication and analytical judgment, with the ability to translate complex risks and requirements into practical actions for technical, business, executive, and Board-level audiences.
* Comfort using AI, automation, data analysis, and reporting tools, with the ability to learn and administer new platforms, document processes, and translate stakeholder needs into workflow improvements.
* A relevant professional certification, such as those from DRI International or the Business Continuity Institute, or equivalent practical experience.

We’re working to build a more inclusive economy where our customers have equal access to opportunity, and we strive to live by these same values in building our workplace. Block is an equal opportunity employer evaluating all employees and job applicants without regard to identity or any legally protected class. We will consider qualified applicants with arrest or conviction records for employment in accordance with state and local laws and “fair chance” ordinances.
  
  
We believe in being fair, and are committed to an inclusive interview experience, including providing reasonable accommodations to disabled applicants throughout the recruitment process. We encourage applicants to share any needed accommodations with their recruiter, who will treat these requests as confidentially as possible.

While there is no specific deadline to apply for this role, U.S. roles are typically open for an average of 55 days before being filled by a successful candidate. Please refer to the date listed at the top of this job page for when this role was first posted.

  

Block takes a market-based approach to pay, and pay may vary depending on your location. U.S. locations are categorized into one of four zones based on a cost of labor index for that geographic area. The successful candidate’s starting pay will be determined based on job-related skills, experience, qualifications, work location, and market conditions. These ranges may be modified in the future.

As Customer Success Manager, you'll lead a team of three Account Managers, owning team performance, customer lifecycle management, and the delivery of exceptional service across our customer base. **What you bring**
------------------

* **People management experience.** 2–3 years managing and developing a team, including performance management and coaching.
* **Customer success background.** 2–3 years in a customer success, account management, or client services role in a SaaS environment, including ownership of lifecycle touchpoints like onboarding, renewals, and escalations.
* **A partner mindset.** You see customer relationships as strategic, not transactional, and you build trust accordingly.
* **Data fluency.** You use account health data to drive decisions and prioritize outreach, not just to report on what already happened.
* **Cross-functional comfort.** You collaborate naturally with Growth, Product, and Professional Services toward shared outcomes.
* **Independent judgment.** You identify problems and build solutions with minimal direction.

**Nice to have**

**About the Role**
------------------

Cyberhaven is looking for a Technical Account Manager to be the technical quarterback for our customers. You will own the full technical picture of each account: how Cyberhaven is architected and deployed, how it integrates with the customer's environment, how it is performing, and whether it is delivering the outcomes the customer bought it for. You will develop deep expertise in Cyberhaven's reimagined Agentic Data Security platform, including its inner workings, data lineage model, endpoint agents, and integrations. You will learn how our customers use it to mitigate data loss threats across their organizations. You are passionate about technology, naturally curious, and driven to exceed customer expectations. You take proactive ownership, anticipating issues before they surface, guiding customers toward best practices, and driving adoption and long-term value. When a problem needs engineering support, you own the escalation, bring a clear reproduction and technical context, and coordinate internally to full resolution.

Technical depth, a strong client focus, and experience with SaaS-based security products and endpoint agents (Windows, macOS, and Linux) are required. You will report to the Manager of Technical Account Managers.

**What You’ll Do**
------------------

* **Own the technical relationship**

  + Act as the technical owner of assigned accounts, with end-to-end knowledge of each customer's architecture, deployment, configuration, policies, and integrations.

  + Monitor account health, agent coverage, and usage patterns. Identify gaps, misconfigurations, and underused capabilities, and recommend optimizations.
  + Create and drive technical success plans that align customer objectives with Cyberhaven capabilities and deliverables.

  + Advise customers on integrations with adjacent technologies such as SIEM, SOAR, and UEBA to extend the value of their deployment.
  + Stay current on industry trends and security best practices, and bring them to customers.

  ### **Resolve and escalate**

  + Analyze, troubleshoot, escalate and resolve complex technical issues across endpoint agents, cloud and SaaS integrations, and platform configuration.
  + Reproduce customer issues and document clear steps to replicate for Engineering and Development.
  + Serve as the internal and external point of contact on critical escalations. Drive prioritization with support engineering and keep customers informed through resolution.
  + Perform root cause analysis and drive preventive follow-ups so issues do not repeat.

  ### **Be the voice of the customer**

  + Coordinate customer feedback and feature requests to Product Management, Development, and Operations, with the technical and business context behind them.
  + Work cross-functionally as the expert on the Customer.
  + Collaborate with Customer Success and Sales on renewals, expansions, and risk mitigation, providing technical input and account insight.
  + Develop and maintain knowledge base articles, playbooks, and best-practice resources.

* 3+ years of hands-on EDR/DLP endpoint experience.
* Expertise with DLP, Insider Threat, and CASB solutions.

* Demonstrated ability to own customer technical outcomes from implementation through steady-state operation, and to understand a customer's architecture and environment end-to-end.
* Hands-on experience deploying, supporting, and troubleshooting SaaS-based security and/or endpoint agent technologies.
* Proven experience resolving escalated technical customer issues and working directly with engineering teams.
* Strong organizational and planning skills, with the ability to manage multiple accounts and priorities, set timelines, track progress, and maintain clear documentation (success plans, project plans, status reports).
* Excellent verbal and written communication skills (English), including the ability to engage both hands-on practitioners and executive stakeholders.
* Practical knowledge of networking, security products, and enterprise network infrastructure.
* Deep knowledge of Windows, macOS, and Linux, including SCCM, GPO, Intune, registry configuration, PowerShell scripting, MDM, application management, and basic terminal skills.
* Software debugging skills: reading and searching logs (Windows, macOS, Linux, and Google Kubernetes Engine), running diagnostic scripts, and process management.

**We are a federal IT company on a mission to make customer experience (CX) the center of every government solution.**

We believe happy employees do amazing work, so join our team NOW! We are currently seeking a Senior Business Analyst for a Full-Time position.

**Job Summary:**

Leads business analysis for complex IT projects, eliciting and documenting detailed requirements from stakeholders across multiple organizational units. Translates business needs into technical specifications and serves as the primary liaison between business stakeholders and technical delivery teams.

**Key Responsibilities**
------------------------

* Elicit, analyze, and document business and functional requirements across multiple stakeholder groups.

new_jobs.description:
**“See It and Be It” Program Coordinator (Richmond Area)**

**STEAM the Streets | Part-Time Contract | 8-15 hours/week | November–March | $30/hour**

**About STEAM the Streets**

STEAM the Streets is a mission-driven organization that uses media, music, arts, and STEAM education to connect young people to careers and inspire them to see new possibilities for their futures.

**About the Role**

STEAM the Streets is seeking a highly organized, proactive **See It and Be It Richmond Area Program Coordinator** to support the delivery of our **See It and Be It** program with our partners at West Contra Costa Unified School District (WCCUSD) Department of College and Career.

This is a **part-time, project-based contract role** responsible for coordinating logistics, communication, and school-site readiness across four participating middle schools. The coordinator will help ensure that the program is organized and ready from initial school coordination through the February assembly week and early curriculum implementation.

The ideal candidate is organized, responsive, comfortable communicating with school staff, and able to manage multiple moving pieces with minimal supervision.

**About the See It and Be It Program**

**See It and Be It** is a career exploration program from STEAM the Streets that introduces middle school students to a range of STEAM careers through engaging classroom curriculum and real-world exposure. The program kicks off with our **“This Can Be You”** career exploration assemblies, followed by classroom-based career exploration that helps students discover new possibilities and pathways for their future.

**Key Responsibilities**

**Program Preparation & Coordination – November–January**

* Onboard with STEAM the Streets and review existing commitments, timelines, contacts, forms, and planning materials for the four participating schools.
* Establish and maintain communication with school administrators and teachers at each site.
* Schedule planning meetings and coordinate follow-up with each school.
* Coordinate deadlines and readiness activities leading up to the February assemblies.
* Ensure January deadlines are met for assembly forms, school site visits, technical checks, schedules, and final confirmations.
* Conduct site visits to assess assembly spaces and document logistics, including room setup, AV/technical needs, parking/loading, student capacity, and arrival procedures.
* Coordinate technical checks and communicate site-specific needs to the STEAM the Streets team.
* Maintain a master schedule and program logistics tracker for all four schools.
* Coordinate catering and materials for the professional development/training session.
* Support preparation and on-site logistics for the December train-the-trainer session for approximately 8–12 WCCUSD educators.
* Coordinate pre-program survey follow-up with participating teachers, ensuring teachers understand their role in distributing and completing student pre-surveys.

**This Can Be You Assembly Week – February 8-12**The coordinator will serve as the primary on-the-ground logistics support for STEAM the Streets during assembly week, ensuring each school is prepared and the team has what it needs to successfully deliver the assemblies.

Responsibilities include:

* Confirm final details with each school prior to arrival.
* Coordinate arrival times and access with school staff and the STEAM the Streets team.
* Ensure spaces, equipment, materials, and other site requirements are ready before each assembly.
* Help coordinate setup and troubleshoot logistical or technical issues that arise.
* Serve as the on-site point person for school logistics and communicate issues to the Founder / CEO as needed.
* Assist with breakdown and ensure materials and equipment are accounted for following each assembly.
* Complete daily follow-up and flag any outstanding issues or changes.

**Program Implementation – March**

* Maintain light-touch communication with participating educators as curriculum implementation begins.
* Follow up with teachers regarding student surveys and other program information.
* Conduct occasional school-site check-ins as needed.
* Track questions, issues, and follow-up items and escalate anything requiring STEAM the Streets leadership.
* Assist with collecting program feedback and basic participation information.

**Ideal Candidate**

* Highly organized and detail-oriented.
* Strong written and verbal communication skills.
* Comfortable communicating with school administrators, teachers, and education professionals.
* Reliable, responsive, and able to manage deadlines independently.
* Comfortable working on-site at schools and during program events.
* Able to anticipate logistical needs and troubleshoot problems calmly.
* Experience in education, youth programs, events, or nonprofit program coordination is a plus.
* Familiarity with WCCUSD or Richmond-area schools is helpful but not required.

**Contract Details**

**Position:** See It and Be It Richmond Area Program Coordinator**Type:** Part-Time Contract**Term:** November–March**Hours:** 8–15 hours per week, with a spike in hours during the February 8–12 assembly week**Rate:** $30/hour**Location:** Richmond area / Hybrid, with required in-person work at district and school sites during program activities**Reports to:** Founder / CEO, STEAM the Streets

**What Success Looks Like**

The coordinator keeps the **See It and Be It** program moving and makes sure each school is prepared, informed, and ready. By the time the STEAM the Streets team arrives at a school, the logistics should be confirmed, the site should be ready, and any potential issues should already be identified and communicated.

**Success means:**

* Each school is informed, prepared, and ready for its scheduled program activities.
* Assembly logistics are confirmed in advance, potential issues are identified early, and each assembly runs smoothly from arrival through breakdown.

new_jobs.description:
**About the California Academy of Sciences**

Founded in 1853, the California Academy of Sciences is a globally renowned, AZA-accredited non-profit scientific and cultural institution located in the heart of San Francisco's Golden Gate Park. Home to a world-class planetarium, aquarium, rainforest, research institute, and natural history museum—all under one living roof—our mission is to regenerate the natural world through science, learning, and collaboration.

Our living collection reflects Earth's vast biodiversity, consisting of nearly 60,000 animals representing over 800 species. Our research collections are the largest west of the Mississippi, spanning nearly 46 million plants, animals, fossils, and cultural artifacts from across the globe and throughout history. Our diverse team includes leading biodiversity scientists, educators, storytellers, designers, and communicators who are passionate about advancing knowledge and catalyzing action through science and storytelling.

Whether you're conducting research behind the scenes or engaging the public on the museum floor, your work will help connect people to the natural world and empower them to protect it.

**About the Opportunity**

  

The Steinhart Aquarium is currently seeking a Registration and Operations Manager to join our team. Reporting to the Curator of Aquarium Operations, this position is split between registration and recordkeeping (approximately 60% of duties) and managing departmental operations (approximately 40% of the role). As the lead registration staff member, you will oversee the Institutional Recordkeeping Program for the Steinhart Aquarium, and ensure that all records are kept up to date and in accordance with the best practices and industry standards set by the Association of Zoos and Aquariums (AZA). Working with minimal oversight and supervision, you will be accountable for managing and maintaining the collection inventory, animal transactions (loans, acquisitions and transfers), births and deaths, transfers between enclosures, behavioral and reproductive notes, and similar program elements. This role ensures that our record-keeping system provides sufficient detail to enhance husbandry, breeding, conservation and medical health advancements to move forward the critical knowledge of species through permanent, retrievable documentation. Operational duties include tracking safety and compliance programs, scheduling meetings and staff training sessions, and coordinating the recruiting and onboarding of departmental volunteers. Work schedule may include weekends, evenings and holidays.

**Organizational Culture**

  

When you join the California Academy of Sciences, you become part of a mission-driven community that values curiosity, collaboration, and innovation, and celebrates its accomplishments together. Staff share a commitment to executing a new strategic plan that will strengthen the organization's financial foundations, cultivate a vibrant internal culture, and foster smart growth to secure the Academy's future.

We hope you are inspired by what we do and are motivated to contribute to our mission. The Academy is looking for candidates who do great work, and we know they may come from a number of different backgrounds and experiences. We encourage you to apply even if you do not believe you meet every qualification for the position.

This position is based in San Francisco, California. The specific onsite/hybrid schedule for this position is listed below.

**This position is part of a bargaining unit represented by Cal Academy Workers United, and will be subject to the terms and conditions of that contract.**

**About the Steinhart Aquarium Team**

Steinhart Aquarium is one of the most biologically diverse and interactive aquariums on Earth. Home to more than 60,000 live plants and animals, representing more than 1,000 unique species, it offers guests an unprecedented view of underwater and terrestrial habitats.

**Key Responsibilities**

  

A critical aspect of this position is maintaining the Steinhart Aquarium Institutional Recordkeeping Program, and assisting departmental managers in maintaining all protocols, procedures, recordkeeping and standards. Responsibilities related to managing the Steinhart Aquarium's animal database, digital workflow, and federal and state permits are expected to account for approximately 60% of the role. These include:

* Animal Records Database – independently responsible for ensuring the accuracy and integrity of our animal collections data in the ZIMS global database, tracking the daily ins and outs of the collection through departmental systems such as PI Reports and Mortality Reports. Trains and onboards all new staff to our recordkeeping systems, policies, and standards, and activates/deactivates staff ZIMS accounts. Ensures that all records are kept up to date and in accordance with the best practices and industry standards set by the Association of Zoos and Aquariums (AZA).
* Permits – independently responsible for ensuring that all departmental state and federal permits are accurate, up to date, and renewed on schedule, and that all annual reporting requirements are completed on schedule.
* Formstack – independently monitors, maintains, and updates our digital workflow and permissions systems in the Formstack software platform.
* Google Suite – independently monitors, maintains, and updates our Google sites page, team drives, and Google email groups.
* Graphics – processes new graphic ID requests for the Steinhart Aquarium and Rainforest exhibits. Collaborates with the Steinhart biologists, IBSS scientists, and Experience Studio to create and produce both digital and printed graphics.

Duties related to departmental operations and administration are expected to account for approximately 40% of the role. These include:

* Safety & Compliance – supports the Curator of Aquarium Operations to ensure that we are operating within all safety and regulatory guidelines
