**Job Title: Community Health Worker**

**About JFS of Silicon Valley (JFSSV):**

Jewish Family Services of Silicon Valley envisions a world where each person achieves self-sufficiency, stability, well-being, and purpose. JFS SV is an inclusive nonprofit social services organization providing comprehensive support services to individuals and families facing life challenges. We engage community partners and collectively we make a positive impact on the lives of those we serve. As an inclusive organization, our biggest strengths are the unwavering support we provide to all employees and the celebration of diversity amongst all communities.

**Job Summary:**

Under the supervision of a Care Manager, the Community Health Worker provides essential administrative, logistical, and direct-support assistance to facilitate the delivery of care management services to CALAIM authorized members. The CHW supports the care management team in coordinating community-based services, conducting outreach, processing referrals, and ensuring clients receive timely and dignified access to the programs and resources they need. This role requires compassion, attention to detail, strong organizational skills, and the ability to work effectively with a diverse population.

**Key Responsibilities:**

Member Outreach & Engagement: Contacting members who may need care coordination, following up on gaps in care, and helping hard-to-reach populations engage with services. Monitor client well-being through regular phone or in-person check-ins and report changes in status to the supervising Care Manager.

Care Coordination Support: Working alongside care managers and nurses to support members with chronic conditions, complex needs, or social determinants of health (SDOH) barriers. Assist Care Managers in implementing individualized care plans for clients. Accompany Care Managers on home visits and community assessments as needed; may conduct follow-up visits independently under supervision.

Navigation & Resource Linkage: Connecting members to community resources such as food assistance, housing, transportation, and behavioral health services. Schedule and coordinate client appointments, home visits, and service provider contacts. Provide clients and caregivers with information about available community resources, benefits programs, and county services. Coordinate linkage to services including IHSS, Meals on Wheels, transportation, adult day programs, mental health services, housing support, and other community-based programs.

Health Education: Providing culturally and linguistically appropriate health education to members and their families.

Administrative Support: Documenting outreach attempts, updating member records, and tracking referrals in the care management system. Assist clients in completing applications for public benefits, including Medi-Cal, CalFresh, Medicare Savings Programs, and other entitlements.

Cultural Bridging: Serving as a liaison between the health plan, providers, and the community, particularly for underserved or non-English-speaking populations.

**Qualifications:**

Education:

* High school diploma or GED, prior experience in community social services, health education and care coordination.

Experience:

* Minimum 1-2 years of experience in a social services, health care, or community-based organization setting.
* Experience working with adults.
* Experience working with underserved, low income or culturally diverse populations, lived experience

Skills and Competencies

* Knowledge of community resources, social service programs, and public benefits available to adults in Santa Clara County.
* Ability to communicate clearly and empathetically with clients, families, and service providers from diverse backgrounds.
* Strong organizational skills with the ability to manage multiple cases and deadlines simultaneously.
* Proficiency in Microsoft Office (Word, Excel, Outlook) and ability to learn case management software.
* Ability to maintain confidentiality and adhere to HIPAA and other privacy regulations.
* Cultural competency and sensitivity
* Ability to navigate community resources and social services
* Basic computer and documentation skills for entering data and tracking outreach
* Motivational interviewing or health coaching skills are a plus

new_jobs.description:
At Ouster, we build sensors and tools for engineers, roboticists, and researchers, so they can make the world safer and more efficient. We've transformed LIDAR from an analog device with thousands of components to an elegant digital device powered by one chip-scale laser array and one CMOS sensor. The result is a full range of high-resolution LIDAR sensors that deliver superior imaging at a dramatically lower price. Our advanced sensor hardware and vision algorithms are used in autonomous cars, drones and many other applications. If you’re motivated by solving big problems, we’re hiring key roles across the company and need your help!  
  
**Role Overview**

We are seeking an execution-focused Senior E-Commerce & Web Operations Manager to co-own the delivery of our web store platform and manage our corporate digital presence as we grow our direct online channel.

In this role, you will be the commercial and operational engine behind our direct online sales channel. You will adopt and scale the proven webstore playbook established by our Stereolabs team, drive self-service adoption for our REV8 sensors and accessories, and rigorously manage our corporate website (Ouster.com) and agency partners to ensure high efficiency, minimal scope creep, and fast execution. Your work will enable Ouster to reach and support customers around the world we previously couldn't serve.

This is an individual contributor role, partnering closely with cross-functional teams, our Stereolabs team in Paris, and external agency and implementation partners.

**Responsibilities**

**Webstore Ownership & GTM Execution**

* Co-Own Project Delivery: Partner with cross-functional teams (Product Strategy, Sales, IT, Legal, Audit, Finance, and Support) to help deliver our webstore launch in a phased approach, then drive the store's day-to-day operations after go-live.
* Playbook Execution: Adopt and adapt the operational e-commerce workflow from our Stereolabs team (Paris) using Shopify and our implementation partner.
* Catalog Management: Own SKU onboarding, implementation of pricing and promotions (in partnership with sales and product strategy), bundles, datasheets, and customer-facing descriptions for Ouster REV8 sensors, cables, and components. This includes managing ongoing changes to SKUs, pricing, and product content as applicable.
* Revenue & Self-Service Growth: Build campaigns and conversion flows to route low-touch, long-tail accounts through self-service e-commerce.
* Performance Reporting: Define and report on webstore KPIs (traffic, conversion, order volume, self-serve revenue, quote deflection) and use them to prioritize improvements.

**Corporate Web Operations & Agency Management (Ouster.com)**

* Website Unification: Lead the consolidation of Stereolabs.com into Ouster.com to streamline our global digital footprint and domain architecture. This includes content migration, redirect mapping, and preservation of search rankings and inbound traffic.
* Agency & Vendor Management: Directly manage our external web agency partners with strict oversight on scope, deliverables, speed, and budget. Shift routine work in-house and right-size the agency engagement over time.
* In-House CMS Management: Use Sanity CMS to swiftly build and launch new landing pages, product pages, and digital assets internally without relying heavily on agency development.

**Qualifications & Requirements**

* Experience: 5+ years owning e-commerce and/or web operations within B2B Hardware, B2C Consumer Tech, B2B Software, Industrial Tech, Marketplaces, or Semiconductor sectors.
* E-Commerce Stack: Hands-on admin experience with Shopify / Shopify Plus, product information architecture, catalog management, and checkout flows.
* Modern CMS & Web Stack: Proven experience with Sanity (or other headless CMS platforms) and managing web design/build projects.
* Site Migrations: Has led at least one domain consolidation or site migration with SEO preserved.
* Agency Management: Demonstrated track record of holding creative and technical agencies accountable to strict budgets, SOWs, and delivery timelines, including cutting agency spend or bringing work in-house.
* Mindset: Pragmatic operator who prioritizes execution and speed-to-market over perfection or unnecessary redesigns.
* Collaboration: Comfortable working across time zones with teams in the US and France.

  
The base pay will be dependent on your skills, work experience, location, and qualifications. This role may also be eligible for equity & benefits. ($130,000 - $170,000)

new_jobs.title: Community Health Worker
new_jobs.description:
**About Us:**

Homebridge serves a high risk, high needs, complex-diagnosed population with a combination of domestic, personal, and homecare functions funded through IHSS. Our work allows an often-underserved population to live safely in their community. Homebridge offers a dynamic, fast-paced work environment with 420+ unionized field workers and 100+ internal office staff.

**Position Summary:**

The Community Health Worker (CHW) plays a vital role in improving the overall health and well-being of individuals and families in the community. They leverage their lived experiences to connect with, support, and encourage those they serve, acting as a liaison between healthcare providers, patients, and community resources. The CHW works in community settings to support underserved and vulnerable populations, helping to navigate complex systems, offer informal counseling, advocate for patient needs, and provide basic health services. They advocate on behalf of individuals by providing referrals to community-based organizations and social services that offer programming and support aligned to their needs, and complete screenings and assessments required to connect clients with appropriate services that support their health and well-being.

**Essential Duties and Responsibilities:**

Community Health Care Track

* Providing personal care and domestic support to older adults and people with disabilities facing gaps in care
* Supporting clients to connect with, engage, and navigate the health care system
* Facilitating access to appropriate medical and behavioral health support by connecting clients with appropriate clinicians, scheduling and providing accompaniment for appointments and follow ups, and supporting with medication management
* Maintaining communication between various members of the client’s Care Team

Social Work Track

* Working closely with on-site staff and other service providers supporting the client to understand their specific needs and available resources
* Identifying factors or behaviors that put the client’s holistic health (physical, mental/behavioral, social, financial, environmental, spiritual, etc) at risk and developing goals and plans in cooperation with the client to address these needs
* Designing and leading sessions that encourage development of independent living/adaptive skills such as use of public transport, inter-personal skills development, and daily living skills (cooking, cleaning, shopping, money management)
* Providing health education and sharing resources that support clients to make healthy lifestyle choices

Sustained Housing Track

* Identifying behaviors that put housing at risk and developing strategies to mitigate them.
* Educating and coaching members about behavior changes that will promote stability in housing.
* Creating and updating housing crisis plans.
* Connecting members to community and social resources to support sustained housing.
* Advocating for members with landlords and building management.

Other duties for CHWs

* Reaching out to potential clients and explaining the benefits of Homebridge services
* Assessing clients' needs and supporting the creation of a care plan with goals related to improving client’s health.
* Providing wrap-round services that improve clients' health and well-being
* Assisting clients to safely navigate transitions in care.
* Identifying and leveraging clients' strengths and support systems to promote self-management.
* Connecting with and educating client's family and social support systems to enable them to better support the client's health.
* Referring clients to social and community services that help them meet their needs and reach their goals.

**Qualifications:**

* High school diploma or equivalent required
* State-recognized CHW/P/R Certificate or at least 2000 hours/1 year of full-time work as a CHW/P/R required.
* 1–2 years’ experience in community-based or healthcare settings preferred.
* Strong computer skills, including Microsoft Office 365 and database navigation.
* English proficiency in reading, writing, and speaking required.
* Bilingual preferred but not required.
* Familiarity with local community and available resources.
* Experience with electronic medical records (EMRs) preferred.
* Ability to work independently and within a diverse, multicultural team.
* Strong organizational skills with the ability to maintain confidentiality and boundaries.

**Physical Requirements:**

* Ability to sit, stand, and walk for extended periods.
* May require occasional lifting up to 25 lbs.
* Must be able to read and interpret handwritten documents and digital information.

**Work Environment:**

* Fast-paced office and community-based environment.
* Frequent interruptions, direct client interactions, and occasional travel required.
* Work may include visits to homes, community centers, or clinics.

Homebridge is an equal opportunity employer. All applicants will be considered for employment without attention to race, color, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, national origin, veteran or disability status.

new_jobs.description:
**About the Role**
------------------

Cyberhaven is looking for a Manager, Technical Account Management to build and lead the team of Technical Account Managers who own the technical relationship with our customers. Your team is accountable for how each customer deploys, adopts, and gets value from Cyberhaven's Agentic Data Security platform, from onboarding through renewal. You will hire and develop the team, define how TAMs work with accounts, and make sure customers get a consistent, proactive technical partner and experience.

You are a people leader with a technical background in security SaaS and endpoint agents, and you are comfortable in a fast-paced, high-growth environment where the team's processes are still being written. You will coach TAMs on and step in on critical escalations when needed. You will also work cross-functionally with Product, Engineering, Support Engineering, Customer Experience, and Sales to turn what the team learns from customers into improvements to the product and to how we serve customers.

Technical depth, a strong client focus, and experience leading customer-facing technical teams are required. You will report to the VP of Support and Technical Account Management.

**What You’ll Do**
------------------

### **Lead and grow the team**

* Hire, onboard, and develop Technical Account Managers. Set clear expectations, give regular feedback, and run career development and performance reviews.
* Coach TAMs on account strategy, technical troubleshooting, executive communication, and managing difficult customer situations.
* Build a team culture of growth mindset, ownership, curiosity, and accountability for customer outcomes.
* Plan headcount and coverage as the customer base grows, including how accounts are assigned and balanced across the team.

### **Define how the TAM function operates**

* Establish the TAM operating model: account segmentation, coverage, engagement cadence, business review format, and technical success plans.
* Set the team's goals and metrics, such as account health, agent coverage and deployment progress, adoption, escalation volume and time to resolution, and customer satisfaction. Report on them to leadership.
* Create and maintain playbooks, runbooks, and knowledge base standards so TAMs handle common situations the same way.
* Define the handoffs between TAMs and Customer Experience and Sales so customers always know who owns what.

### **Own customer outcomes**

* Review account health across the team's book of business and step in early on accounts at risk of low adoption, deployment problems, or churn.
* Act as the senior escalation point for critical customer issues. Make sure TAMs bring clear reproductions and context to Engineering, and that customers stay informed through resolution.
* Build relationships with customes, and join executive and business reviews for strategic accounts.
* Work with Customer Success and Sales on renewals, expansions, and risk mitigation, providing technical input and account insight.

### **Be the voice of the customer**

* Collect customer feedback, feature requests, and recurring issues from the team and bring them to Product Management and Engineering with the technical and business context behind them.
* Work with Engineering and Support Engineering to improve diagnostics, debugging tools, and escalation processes.
* Run root cause analysis reviews on significant incidents and drive preventive follow-ups so issues do not repeat.
* Stay current on industry trends, security best practices, and adjacent technologies such as SIEM, SOAR, and UEBA, and bring them into the team's guidance to customers.

**Who You Are**
---------------

* 3+ years of experience managing a team of Technical Account Managers, Support Engineers, Solutions Engineers, or similar customer-facing technical staff.
* 7+ years in customer-facing technical roles.
* Track record of hiring, developing, and retaining strong technical people, and of handling performance issues directly and fairly.
* Experience building or scaling a TAM, Support, or Customer Success function, including processes, playbooks, and metrics.
* Demonstrated ability to own customer technical outcomes from implementation through steady-state operation, and to understand a customer's architecture and environment end-to-end.
* Hands-on experience deploying, supporting, and troubleshooting SaaS-based security and/or endpoint agent technologies.
* Proven experience managing escalated technical customer issues and working directly with engineering teams.
* Excellent verbal and written communication skills (English), including the ability to engage both hands-on practitioners and executive stakeholders.
* Strong organizational and planning skills, with the ability to manage multiple priorities, set timelines, and track progress across a team and its accounts.
* Practical knowledge of networking, security products, enterprise network infrastructure, and Windows, macOS, and Linux endpoint management (SCCM, GPO, Intune, MDM, and application management).
* Ability to read and interpret logs and diagnostic output across Windows, macOS, Linux, and Google Kubernetes Engine well enough to coach others and guide technical investigations.

### **Desired**

* Familiarity with adjacent technologies that Cyberhaven integrates with (SIEM, SOAR, UEBA).
* Expertise with DLP, Insider Threat, and CASB solutions.
* Prior experience leading a TAM team at a security or SaaS company.
* Experience working in an early-stage or high-growth company where the team's processes were still being defined.
* Background in L2/L3 or Escalation Engineering for EDR or DLP tools.

Joining Cyberhaven means joining the team building Data Security for the Agentic Enterprise. Traditional tools fall short. Cyberhaven traces the full lifecycle of your data, adapting protection to changing context, so protection moves with the way people actually work, not against it. AI Changed Work. We Protect It.

new_jobs.title: Prime Client Services Associate
new_jobs.description:
BitGo (NYSE: BTGO) is the digital asset infrastructure company delivering custody, wallets, staking, trading, financing, stablecoins, and settlement services from regulated cold storage. Since 2013, BitGo has focused on accelerating the transition of the financial system to a digital asset economy. BitGo maintains a global presence and multiple regulated entities, including BitGo Bank & Trust, National Association, the first federally chartered digital asset trust bank owned by a publicly traded company. Today, BitGo serves thousands of institutions, including many of the industry's top brands, financial institutions, exchanges, and platforms, and millions of investors worldwide. For more information, visit www.bitgo.com.

BitGo is the leader in digital asset financial services, providing institutional investors with liquidity, custody, and security solutions. Founded in 2013, BitGo pioneered the multi-signature wallet and is the first digital asset company to focus exclusively on serving institutional clients. Active in both centralized and decentralized finance, BitGo offers market leading trading, lending, and borrowing services through its prime brokerage services and acts as the custodian for WBTC, the leading global stablecoin for Bitcoin. In 2020, BitGo launched BitGo Portfolio and Tax, providing clients with a full-stack solution for digital assets. In 2018, it launched BitGo Trust Company, the first qualified custodian purpose-built for storing digital assets. BitGo processes approximately 20% of all global Bitcoin transactions, and supports over 600 coins and tokens. BitGo provides the security and operational backbone for more than 1500 institutional clients in 50 countries, including many regulated entities and the world's top cryptocurrency exchanges and platforms. BitGo is backed by Goldman Sachs, Craft Ventures, Digital Currency Group, DRW, Galaxy Digital Ventures, Redpoint Ventures, and Valor Equity Partners.

The BitGo Prime team is a dynamic, high performing group that provides critical operational service to our institutional trading, lending, and borrowing clients in partnership with our Trust custody and compliance entity; global account managers and salespeople; and finance and accounting. Our extended unit consists of a diverse group of trading, lending, and KYC/AML professionals with extensive backgrounds in traditional and crypto-finance, including front, middle, and back office.

The Prime Client Services Associate will be responsible for managing business operations for BitGo Prime's digital asset trading and financing services.

**RESPONSIBILITIES**:

* Manage BitGo Prime's trade and settlement workflows including trade entry, asset transfers, reporting and reconciliation.
* Collaborate with Prime's business team to maintain optimal funding across various trading venues
* First line of support for trading or financing operations related enquiries
* Lead process improvements, identify gaps, recommend improvements and automation
* Support testing efforts for all enhancements of proprietary systems
* Produce daily, weekly and monthly reporting for internal and external stakeholders
* Assist the Sales and Client Services team with on-boarding new counterparties
* Identifying operational risks, introduce operational controls and document policies & procedures
* Collaborate closely with the product/engineering team to improve our products and services
* Develop and maintain relationships with clients, exchanges, liquidity providers and third party providers
* Stay up to date about market trends, opportunities, risks and new projects, with a passion for the digital asset industry

**SKILLS AND EXPERIENCE:**

BitGo is looking for people who are passionate about their craft, take full ownership for their work and projects, and believe in transparent and collaborative culture with the goal of making BitGo successful.

* Incredible attention to detail and organizational skills
* Able to effectively interact with others in a pleasant, professional manner
* Strong analytical skills and ability to understand assets flows and procedures
* Must have previous middle or back-office experience in a financial services Trading, stock loan, FX experience is a plus.
* Experience managing and interacting with clients is a plus
* Comfortably manage competing priorities in a fast-moving, dynamic start-up environment
* Hands-on Excel or Google Sheets experience; macro programming exposure is a plus
* Genuine interest in financial services and cryptocurrency; crypto experience professionally or personally is a plus
* Bachelor's degree from an accredited university, or equivalent experience

**Why Join BitGo?**

Disrupting an industry takes vision, innovation, passion, technical chops, drive to deliver, collaboration, and execution. Join a team of great people who strive for excellence and personify our corporate values of ownership, craftsmanship, and open communication. We are looking for new colleagues who bring innovative ways of thinking and problem solving, and who want risks to be part of the team that changes the world's financial markets.

Cryptocurrencies are the most disruptive change the financial services industry has seen in years. Join us and you'll be able to look back and say you were part of the team that transformed investing.

Partners with customers to translate technical requirements into practical solutions related to system configuration, user access, connected devices, external-system interfaces, reporting, and workflows.

The Power Solutions – Project Manager is accountable for leading and delivering electrical power solutions projects for mission critical facilities, including hyperscale data centers, utility, renewable, industrial, and energy storage environments. The role combines project leadership with broad technical coordination across electrical infrastructure, system design, energy storage, microgrid, interconnection, protection and control, and related power delivery needs.

The Project Manager works closely with internal engineering teams, clients, utilities, vendors, subconsultants, and external stakeholders to define project needs and ensure solutions are delivered accurately, on schedule, and within budget, while maintaining alignment with DLB standards, client requirements, applicable codes, and industry best practices.

The Project Manager will receive limited direction on day-to-day work and general instruction on new projects or assignments. Will execute and assist project leadership on projects of complex scope. Will work independently or under limited supervision and may coordinate the work of others.

* Coordinate and manage subconsultants, vendors, and external partners, including scope definition, performance monitoring, proposal review, bid leveling, and deliverable review.

new_jobs.description:
Block is one company built from many blocks, all united by the same purpose of economic empowerment. The blocks that form our foundational teams — People, Finance, Counsel, Hardware, Information Security, Platform Infrastructure Engineering, and more — provide support and guidance at the corporate level. They work across business groups and around the globe, spanning time zones and disciplines to develop inclusive People policies, forecast finances, give legal counsel, safeguard systems, nurture new initiatives, and more. Every challenge creates possibilities, and we need different perspectives to see them all. Bring yours to Block.

#### **The Role**

Block’s Business Resilience is part of the Security Governance Risk and Compliance team. The Business Resilience helps ensure that critical products, services, operations, and supporting technology can continue through disruption and recover within expected timeframes. The team partners across business, technology, risk, compliance, legal, regional entities, and third-party teams to identify resilience risks, validate recovery capabilities, support governance expectations, and drive practical remediation.

This role will help operate and mature Block’s resilience program across business continuity, disaster recovery, crisis management, operational resilience, third-party resilience, testing, reporting, and regulatory compliance support. The role requires someone who can translate resilience requirements into clear business and technology actions, communicate risk in a practical way, and support accountable owners through testing, remediation, and governance.

The ideal candidate is also comfortable improving how resilience work gets done. They should be able to identify manual or repeatable workflows, support AI-enabled and automation opportunities, improve reporting and dashboards, help administer resilience tooling, and build scalable templates, evidence processes, and self-service mechanisms that reduce friction while improving quality, auditability, and regulatory confidence.

#### **You Will**

* Identify resilience risks across critical services, business functions, technology, and dependencies, including risks introduced by business, regulatory, or industry changes.
* Develop and maintain current, testable business continuity, disaster recovery, and crisis management plans aligned with recovery objectives, strategies, and resource needs.
* Coordinate resilience exercises and recovery tests, report findings, and partner with accountable owners to track remediation through completion.
* Assess third-party continuity and recovery capabilities, identify gaps, and support remediation.
* Communicate resilience posture, open risks, and decisions needed to governance forums, senior leaders, and Boards, and support audit, regulatory, customer, and RFP requests.
* Partner with regional entities, including the UK, EU, and Canada, to align global practices with local requirements and reduce duplication through shared controls, evidence, and reporting.
* Improve resilience workflows through AI, automation, dashboards, templates, and self-service tools, supporting requirements, testing, adoption, and troubleshooting with appropriate data, access, auditability, and human review controls.

#### **You Have**

* 6+ years of experience operating or improving global resilience, business continuity, disaster recovery, crisis management, or related risk programs, ideally in financial services or regulated technology.
* Strong knowledge of impact analysis, dependency mapping, recovery strategies, testing, remediation, and governance, with experience applying relevant standards or regulatory expectations (i.e. ISO22301, BS11200, FFIEC, EBA, FCI, CBI, or RPAA).
* Strong project management, organizational, and partnership skills, with the ability to manage deadlines and dependencies and drive cross-functional follow-through without direct authority.
* Excellent communication and analytical judgment, with the ability to translate complex risks and requirements into practical actions for technical, business, executive, and Board-level audiences.
* Comfort using AI, automation, data analysis, and reporting tools, with the ability to learn and administer new platforms, document processes, and translate stakeholder needs into workflow improvements.
* A relevant professional certification, such as those from DRI International or the Business Continuity Institute, or equivalent practical experience.

We’re working to build a more inclusive economy where our customers have equal access to opportunity, and we strive to live by these same values in building our workplace. Block is an equal opportunity employer evaluating all employees and job applicants without regard to identity or any legally protected class. We will consider qualified applicants with arrest or conviction records for employment in accordance with state and local laws and “fair chance” ordinances.
  
  
We believe in being fair, and are committed to an inclusive interview experience, including providing reasonable accommodations to disabled applicants throughout the recruitment process. We encourage applicants to share any needed accommodations with their recruiter, who will treat these requests as confidentially as possible.

Resolv Global is a global customer operations and outsourcing company helping businesses scale through people, technology, AI, and global delivery.

We provide solutions across customer experience, sales, technical support, back-office operations, financial services, and other business-critical functions.

We are looking for a **hands-on Marketing Manager** to help take Resolv Global's brand, visibility, and B2B marketing to the next level.

**About the Role**

This is a **hands-on B2B marketing role**, not simply a position focused on managing agencies or maintaining a marketing calendar.

You will own and execute marketing initiatives across **LinkedIn, content, brand, sales enablement, digital marketing, and campaigns**, working closely with Sales, leadership, web, and SEO resources.

You should be someone who can take an idea and turn it into a polished piece of marketing, whether that's a LinkedIn campaign, client proposal, pitch deck, case study, landing page, or thought leadership piece.

**Key Responsibilities**

* Develop and execute B2B marketing campaigns that increase brand visibility and generate meaningful business interest.
* Own Resolv Global's LinkedIn and social media content strategy.
* Create compelling content, graphics, thought leadership, and executive content.
* Develop sales enablement materials including proposals, pitch decks, presentations, case studies, and one-pagers.
* Support website content, landing pages, messaging, and conversion improvements.
* Work with SEO resources on SEO, content, AEO/GEO, and AI-search initiatives.
* Partner with Sales and leadership to support business development and priority campaigns.
* Track marketing performance and continuously improve campaigns based on results.
* Maintain a consistent and professional Resolv Global brand across all channels.

**Contract & Compensation**

* Independent Contract
* Salary based on experience
* Paid in USD weekly
* Fully remote position
* Open to candidates from South Africa, Canada, and the US

**The Person We're Looking For**

We want a **builder, not a caretaker**.

You enjoy creating things, solving problems, moving quickly, and turning business ideas into marketing that people actually notice.

You understand that B2B marketing is about more than likes and impressions. It's about **building credibility, supporting sales, creating demand, and helping the right companies understand why Resolv Global is worth talking to.**

If you're a hands-on B2B marketer ready to make a visible impact within a growing global company, **we'd love to hear from you.**

  
Requirements:  
  

**What We're Looking For**

You should have:

* Proven B2B marketing experience, particularly on LinkedIn.
* Strong writing and business communication skills.
* Hands-on experience creating content and campaigns.

* Working knowledge of digital marketing, SEO, and content marketing.
* Experience working with Sales and senior leadership.
* Strong visual judgment and attention to detail.
